“Skeletons and Zombies?”

fact: Grygum and Jimjar agree to a bet on the type of monsters found in the tomb, with skeletons and zombies as the chosen wager.

Buppido is emphatic that this will leave a trail.
For some reason, Zalthir believes Buppido. There is something about the Derro’s conviction.

He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge. He drops down as he gets to the other side of the gorge.

subject: debate over corpse disposal
fact: A massive debate erupted over whether to leave or dispose of the bandits’ corpses. Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believed monsters would hinder pursuers; Shuushar dismissed tracking from ecological disturbance as absurd; Buppido insisted it would leave a trail. Zalthir sided with Buppido, and the bodies were dropped into the gorge.
source_quote: What to do with corpses is a significant ecological, Philosophical, and existential problem in the Underdark.

subject: debate over escape route
fact: The group debates whether to go to Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or follow the Darklake, with Shuushar unwilling to go past Sloobludop.
source_quote: He shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone. ... Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first... Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous... Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

All those within the cloud may be poisoned for about a minute and, when poisoned, are affected by the same effects of a confusion spell.'

The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate. Although the Ordning was re-established, the giant civil war continued. And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: Eldeth

The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate. Although the Ordning was re-established, the giant civil war continued. And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: Eldeth

source_quote: Near a pool of water, the Eldeth smiles. She has found waterorbs. ... "Stop," she shouts. She is standing in front of a cave covered with mushrooms. She shouts, "Tinmmasks." ... She looks at a corpse, "that’s what happened to that guy."

subject: Eldeth

subject: Eldeth

subject: Eldeth

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin experienced a sudden episode of screaming, laughing, and weeping, lasting ten minutes, after which he claimed no memory of the event but was fine. He later volunteered to climb the cavern roof to cross a gorge, overheard a bet about his success, tied a rope around his waist, and completed the climb — only to be attacked by hidden crossbowmen on the other side. He survived the fight and declared the group no longer owed Jimjar money.
source_quote: I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.

subject: Thorin

He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believe monsters will be a hindrance if corpses are left.
source_quote: Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believe that the monsters will be a hindrance.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: Shuushar believes trackers cannot discern anything from the circle of life.
source_quote: Shuushar feels that the notion that trackers can discern anything from what the circle of life is is absurd.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: The group debates whether to leave the bandit corpses or dispose of them to avoid attracting trackers.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to the locals, 'Do we leave the bodies here, and will the ecosystem of monsters impede our pursuers? Or should we dispose of the bodies because it will be a trail?'

subject: Drow of Velkynvelve
fact: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten by the group.
source_quote: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten.

subject: escape route strategy
fact: The group debates whether to go to Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or follow the Darklake, with conflicting opinions on safety and access.
source_quote: He shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone. ... Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first... Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous... Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

subject: Faerzress-induced sensory distortion
fact: The Faerzress’s magic altered colors for Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait and deeply affected Sethir — an ongoing environmental mystery that may influence future perception or sanity.
source_quote: Yuk Yuk and Spiderbait find the colors somehow different than they are used to. And Sethir seems particularly affected.

subject: giant civil war legacy
fact: Eldeth’s lingering trauma over the War of the Giants and Thorin’s defense of 'different giants' suggests an unresolved ideological and emotional rift regarding giant heritage that may resurface.
source_quote: The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate.

subject: lost temple
fact: Sethir insists on investigating the lost temple to find treasure, suggesting it is a potential destination.
source_quote: Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure.

subject: murder mystery
fact: The identity of Yuk Yuk’s killer is unknown, and all group members are potential suspects.
source_quote: Grygum examines the cut and notes, 'It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it.'

subject: Ploopploopeen’s identity
fact: Shuushar claims Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother who welcomes awakenings to the end of their people’s madness, while Grygum thinks the name is a tongue twister.
source_quote: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help. "Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness." ... Grygum mutters, "That’s quite a bit of tongue twister."

subject: Ploopploopeen’s potential aid
fact: Shuushar’s mention of Ploopploopeen, the archpriest of Sloobludop, introduces a possible future contact who may help those affected by the madness of their people’s end — an unresolved thread.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness.

subject: The destination debate
fact: The group’s conflicting opinions on whether to go to Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or the lost temple remain unresolved.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy find the name off-putting. Jimjar is mildly disinterested. Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure. Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first... Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels. Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

subject: The origin of the bandits' truce
fact: The bandits’ story of being lost in a dungeon is suspected to be a fabrication, but their true motive remains unverified.
source_quote: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir realize that the story is a fabrication and that the details are not that important.

subject: Thorin’s madness
fact: Thorin’s sudden emotional breakdown is unexplained, and whether it is PTSD, Underdark stress, or a religious ritual remains unresolved.
source_quote: After about ten minutes, during which no one is sure if he’s suffering from PTSD, whether the stress of the Underdark has become too much, or whether this is some religious ritual, he recovers.

subject: Thorin’s relationship with giants
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s connection to giants offputting due to the unresolved civil war among giants after the War of the Dragons, despite the Ordning’s re-establishment.
source_quote: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting. The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate. Although the Ordning was re-established, the giant civil war continued. And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: Thorin's relationship with giants
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants off-putting.
source_quote: But the shield dwarf finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting.

subject: tinderbox and toasted Ripplebark
fact: Jimjar declares toasted Ripplebark the best thing in the Underdark, linking the tinderbox to culinary preference and survival utility.
source_quote: Jimjar, however, is excited about the tinderbox - "Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark."
